surprises.description: Celeste contributed more than 40% of net new bookings, well above the preview’s >25% thesis-validation bar and more than double the prior quarter’s >20%.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Celeste represented more than 40% of net new bookings in Q1, up from over 20% in the prior quarter.”

surprises.description: Q1 total revenue beat both the preview’s consensus and the company’s guidance range, though by a relatively small amount.
surprises.expectation_evidence: “Q1 FY27 Guidance” of $159.3–$160.3M and “Q1 FY27 Consensus” of $159.6M.

surprises.description: Subscription revenue exceeded the preview’s expected SaaS range, growing 29% rather than the roughly 27.5% expected. The preview noted that the Q1 guided $123.7–$124.7M line was SaaS, despite some sources labeling it subscription revenue.
surprises.expectation_evidence: “SaaS revenue” guidance of $123.7–$124.7M and expected growth of “~+27.5%.”

surprises.description: Non-GAAP operating income and margin came in above the preview’s guidance-based expectations: income exceeded the $34.4M high end, and the 22% margin was above the roughly 21.2% implied by guidance.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Non-GAAP operating income more than doubled to $35.4 million for a 22% margin.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: Q1 non-GAAP operating income guidance of “$33.4 – $34.4M”; the preview said Q1 guidance implied “21.2% non-GAAP OI margin.”

surprises.description: Cloud ARR growth was a little slower than the preview’s 29% target and its roughly $520M base case: it reached $515.3M and grew 28%. It stayed above the preview’s 27%-handle bear-case concern, so the shortfall was limited.
surprises.expectation_evidence: “Q1 needs ≥$518M to hold 29%. My base is ~$520M.”

surprises.description: The FY2027 total-revenue guidance raise was smaller than the preview said the market needed: the new high end is $662.2M, only $1.7M above the previous $660.5M high end and below the preview’s $664M threshold. The guidance was raised, but not by enough to meet that stated bar.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Full-year FY2027 guidance calls for … total revenue of $658.2-$662.2 million.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: “The bar is a raise of ≥$4–6M above the current $660.5M high end”; the catalyst checklist also called for “FY27 revenue guide raised to ≥$664M.”

surprises.description: Management said Celeste demand had outpaced the company’s ability to deploy it, an execution bottleneck not anticipated in the preview. The large trial pipeline—including over 200 enterprise firms not yet converted to full subscriptions—shows the demand but also the near-term conversion constraint.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Qualified Celeste pipeline reached an all-time high, growing approximately 2.5x quarter-over-quarter, with over 200 enterprise firms running Celeste but not yet converted to full subscriptions”; management said demand was “running ahead of its deployment capacity,” requiring additional firm-deployed engineers.

surprises.description: The preview highlighted a recent pattern of 100-plus net additions to the $100,000-plus client cohort, but the cohort rose by only 11 from Q4, from 897 to 908. Its year-over-year growth was still positive, but the sequential additions were well below that recent pace.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Clients above $100,000 in ARR reaching 908” from 897 at Q4.
surprises.expectation_evidence: The preview described “4th straight quarter of 100+ net adds” for clients above $100K ARR.
